2609.22696.title: Building Trustworthy Mental Health Benchmarks on Bluesky: A Validation-Aware Weak-Supervision Framework
2609.22696.paper_summary: Decentralized social media platforms create new opportunities and challenges for computational mental health research because data access, moderation, labeling, and deployment responsibilities are distributed across multiple technical and governance layers. This paper presents a validation-aware weak-supervision system for constructing and evaluating suicidal ideation (SI) and broader mental health (MH) disclosure benchmarks on Bluesky, a decentralized social media platform built on the AT Protocol. The system integrates public firehose collection, task-specific lexicon filtering, Llama-3-8B-assisted binary annotation, human-adjudicated validation subsets, and transformer-based model benchmarking. Using this pipeline, we construct two task-specific corpora containing 8,346 SI-labeled posts and 9,988 MH-labeled posts. The evaluation shows that model performance depends strongly on both task definition and validation protocol. BERT+LSTM achieves the highest SI stratified cross-validation F1-score, RoBERTa achieves the strongest SI holdout F1-score, and DistilRoBERTa achieves the best MH cross-validation F1-score. Human validation reveals different weak-label failure modes across tasks, with SI labels dominated by false negatives and MH labels dominated by false positives. These findings show that decentralized social media can support reproducible mental health benchmarking, but only when system design, label provenance, validation strategy, and deployment constraints are evaluated together.
2609.22696.paper_summary_zh: 去中心化社交媒體平台為計算心理健康研究創造了新的機會和挑戰，因為數據訪問、管理、標記和部署責任分散在多個技術和治理層面上。本文提出了一個驗證感知的弱監督系統，用於在基於AT協議的去中心化社交媒體平台Bluesky上構建和評估自殺意念（SI）和更廣泛的心理健康（MH）披露基準。該系統整合了公共數據流收集、特定任務的詞彙過濾、Llama-3-8B輔助的二元標註、人為裁定的驗證子集和基於Transformer的模型基準測試。通過這個管道，我們構建了兩個特定任務的語料庫，包含8,346條SI標記的帖子和9,988條MH標記的帖子。評估顯示，模型性能在很大程度上依賴於任務定義和驗證協議。BERT+LSTM達到了最高的SI分層交叉驗證F1分數，RoBERTa達到了最強的SI保留F1分數，而DistilRoBERTa則達到了最佳的MH交叉驗證F1分數。人為驗證揭示了不同任務之間的弱標籤失效模式，其中SI標籤以假陰性為主，而MH標籤則以假陽性為主。這些發現表明，去中心化社交媒體可以支持可重複的心理健康基準測試，但只有在系統設計、標籤來源、驗證策略和部署限制一起評估的情況下。
